The shift at 3.81 ppm is consistent with a methoxy group. The shifts at 2.85 and 3.09 ppm suggest aliphatic protons, possibly part of a cyclic structure or connected to heteroatoms. Given the molecular formula C12H16O2 and the presence of aromatic and methoxy groups, a possible structure could be an aromatic compound with methoxy substituents. The halogens ['Cl', 'Br'] might be part of the structure as substituents. I will now propose a structure and provide the SMILES representation.
